items.alt: Hand holding a piece of charcoal over a charcoal pile
items.title: Premium lump charcoal
items.desc: Our main product is a high-quality charcoal made from selected hardwoods: Curupaú (Anadenanthera colubrina) and Quebracho Colorado (Schinopsis brasiliensis), known for their high density, strength and excellent energy yield.
features: Suitable for industrial and export markets

spec.v: Bulk / Big bags / 5, 10 and 30 kg bags

items.app: Dense, steady-burning fuel for grilling and gastronomy, and industrial charcoal for steelmaking.

items.alt: Bottle of pyroligneous acid in a crop field
items.title: Pyroligneous acid
items.desc: Pyroligneous acid, also known as wood vinegar, is a natural agricultural bio-input obtained by condensing and purifying the vapours released during wood carbonisation. Rich in organic acids and bioactive compounds, it acts as a biostimulant, a root-development promoter, an enhancer of soil biological activity and an aid in managing fungi, bacteria, nematodes and certain pests. It also improves nutrient uptake, crop vigour and composting, adding value to more efficient and sustainable agriculture.
features: Can be used as an agricultural biostimulant
Acts as a natural insect repellent
Can support the control of soil fungi and diseases
Applied diluted with water, liquid compost, biofertilisers or organic preparations
Helps reduce dependence on synthetic chemicals
items.app: Crop protection, natural pest control and fewer chemical inputs.

spec.v: Settled, filtered and free of suspended solids

items.title: Charcoal briquettes
items.desc: Charcoal briquettes are a solid fuel made from charcoal fines, compacted and upgraded through a controlled process. They offer higher density, uniform size, easier handling and storage, steadier combustion and efficient use of material, turning the fines generated in production into a high-value commercial product for household, gastronomic and industrial use.
items.app: High-performance fuel for grills, gastronomy and gourmet export.

process.label: Process
process.title: Thermal precision and process control in every carbonisation cycle.
process.lede: Wood is carbonised in a closed retort through a controlled thermal process. Each stage is monitored in real time by four probes connected to Piroliswiss Control, ensuring precision, efficiency and uniformity in every cycle.

ui.aria: Retort in the {phase} phase; probes at {t} °C

phases.name: Drying
phases.text: The wood loses its moisture. Water vapour leaves through the chimney before decomposition begins.

phases.name: Torrefaction
phases.text: Hemicellulose breaks down and the wood darkens. The first vapours condense as pyroligneous acid.

phases.name: Carbonisation
phases.text: Cellulose and lignin break down. Gas that does not condense returns to the burner and heats the retort itself.

phases.name: Refining
phases.text: The last volatiles are driven off and fixed carbon rises. The result is a more stable charcoal of consistent quality.

control.label: Control and traceability
control.title: Smart monitoring in every cycle.
control.lede: Piroliswiss Control is our kiln supervision and monitoring system. It records the temperature of every retort in real time, detects deviations during the cycle and stores the thermal curve of every load to ensure traceability, control and consistent operation.

points.title: Four probes per kiln
points.text: Front, centre, back and gas outlet. The spread between probes shows whether the load carbonises evenly.

points.title: Cycle phases
points.text: Loading, heating and pyrolysis are detected from temperature, with the start time and duration of each phase.

points.title: Real-time alarms
points.text: Immediate warning when a kiln passes its threshold, a probe fails or a node stops sending data. Without a connection, readings are queued and sent later.

points.title: Per-lot record
points.text: Every cycle is stored and can be exported, so each lot can be traced back to its temperature curve.
